leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize the Node.js built-in performance measurement APIs
Construct performance timers to measure execution time of code blocks
Apply memory usage monitoring to identify potential leaks
Configure the Node.js profiler to generate performance reports
Manipulate profiling data to analyze CPU bottlenecks
Integrate performance hooks to track asynchronous operations
Implement basic performance optimization techniques based on profiling results
